## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      10 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 16, 2026 - Sep 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Uyen Vo_, Sep 25, 2026, 1/5: "The app automatically charge my credit card eventhough I cancelled subscription already."
            2. _fawn marek_, Sep 20, 2026, 1/5: "I canceled this subscription and deleted the app yet they still charge me! beware! scam"
            3. _Lorna Carroll_, Sep 21, 2026, 5/5: "I'm really pleasantly surprised with this app, I had downloaded it for the free trial calisthenics challenge, fully expecting to cancel and delete it at the end of the trial but I can honestly say I really enjoy the workouts, look forward to doing them and miss it if I've not done a workout. But let's talk about results! I never ever thought I'd see abs on my body, people are commenting on how toned I look (even with the loose skin after 6st weight loss) All in all Im loving the app."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 23, 2026 - Sep 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Engin Volkan_, Sep 23, 2026, 1/5: "30 day money back guarantee has conditions which is only visible in the details of their policy. Do not assume that you can easily change your mind in 30 days. Once they have your money, they'll hold on to that as much as possible like they'll ask for screenshots and proof of usage for 7 days. How exactly is this a guarantee? Check their policy and don't be fooled with their ads. Buggy onboarding, survey keeps crashing, support manually changed it two times, but I still need proof, right..."
            2. _Bonolo Rambau_, Sep 15, 2026, 1/5: "the app glitches, i can't even access my meal plan. I have been a member for less than an hour"
            3. _Sabina Kotiranta_, May 23, 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
